newsitem.title: USA: Wisconsin Energy to meet with regulators.
newsitem.headline: Wisconsin Energy to meet with regulators.

text.p: The Nuclear Regulatory Commission said Wednesday it scheduled a meeting with Wisconsin Electric Power Co to discuss regulatory issues at the company's Point Beach Nuclear Power Station, including possible safety violations.

Among the issues to be discussed is a May 28 incident in which hydrogen ignited during welding on a spent fuel storage cask at the plant, which is in Two Rivers, Wis., about 100 miles north of Milwaukee.

The meeting, billed as an enforcement conference, is scheduled for September 12. But the agency said that does not mean it has determined that a violation has occurred or that enforcement action will be taken.
Wisconsin Electric Power is a unit of Wisconsin Energy Corp.
